name: erp-remotenyx-agent
description: Specialized GitHub Copilot agent for ERP Remotenyx development

coding_patterns.api_structure: RESTful endpoints with proper HTTP methods

prompts.code_generation: Generate code following ERP Remotenyx patterns with proper error handling, PostgreSQL integration, and Tailwind styling
prompts.bug_fixing: Analyze ERP-specific issues focusing on database connections, JWT authentication, and API responses
prompts.testing: Create comprehensive tests for ERP modules including unit tests for models, integration tests for APIs, and component tests
prompts.documentation: Generate documentation following ERP business context with examples for CRM, HR, Finance, and Inventory modules
prompts.refactoring: Optimize code for performance, maintainability, and ERP-specific requirements like data consistency and user permissions
prompts.database: Generate PostgreSQL queries optimized for ERP operations with proper indexing and relationship handling

custom_commands./generate-module: Create a new ERP module with all necessary files (model, controller, routes, frontend components)
custom_commands./optimize-query: Optimize PostgreSQL queries for better performance
custom_commands./create-test-suite: Generate comprehensive test suite for specified module
custom_commands./generate-api-docs: Create OpenAPI documentation for API endpoints
custom_commands./refactor-component: Refactor React component with best practices

naming.files: kebab-case for components, camelCase for utilities

structure.components: One component per file with default export
structure.api_routes: RESTful structure with proper HTTP methods
structure.models: Class-based with static methods for queries

react_component.pattern: Functional component with hooks, Tailwind classes, proper props validation

api_endpoint.pattern: Express router with validation, authentication middleware, error handling

database_model.pattern: Class with static methods, PostgreSQL queries, mock fallbacks

configuration.pattern: Environment-based config with validation and fallbacks
